title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid files for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Concrete Block Insulating Systems, Inc.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid

milestones.label: Initial filing
milestones.detail: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid

filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-13).
